code_contracts.fact: Metadata sibling serialization uses NTFS upcase name sorting; it does not sort by requested DOS numeric suffix.

Rust extraction representative selection prefers DOS-bearing hardlink path; native class40 shortname setter used before other links. This Rust extractor is not V13 Windows Setup.

limitations: Oracle walk preserves each sibling order but its directory stack order is not a proven Windows Setup creation order
Raw INDEX sort/reference order does not prove historical source creation order
Resource offsets or WIM hardlink inode IDs are not target file references
Production Rust extraction code is not the Windows Setup apply engine used by V13
SourceCore lower MFTrecord than Processor is not direct creation-time evidence; MFTrecords may be reused
